record.text: I got a world series game to listen to. And college football. And the Cavaliers are playing. I don't know if I can do this one tonight.
Cavaliers face Washington Wizards, who debut AJ Dybantsa. Cleveland's lineup: Harden, Mitchell, Watson, Mobley, Allen. via Sports Illustrated

"STOP MAKING ME LIKE THE KNICKS!"

- This Cavaliers fan

value.text: So happy to know the NY Knicks have decided not to share their happiness & pride with Donald Trump at that poor excuse for a White House. I hope James Dolan, their owner & Trump's friend, is upset by that. After his debacle with the rings, Dolan deserves every embarrassment they can heap on him.
